research_project_e5b85512e64140cfa6ecbbe.description: Exactly one real, shared, ground-truthed HTR asset exists in this repository at template-authoring time: tests/fixtures/htr/trolldomskommissionen_sample_line.jpg (a single line from Riksarkivet's trolldomskommissionen_lines dataset, 17th-century Swedish court-record handwriting) plus its ground-truth transcription .txt file. A separate, hand-authored (not genuine Transkribus vendor output -- see tests/fixtures/transkribus/README.md) PAGE XML fixture, sample_page.xml, supplies the page-level, non-corresponding Transkribus input. This is NOT a multi-document research corpus; see scope_caveats.
